sn1.47:1.2: Both by day and by night?
sn1.47:1.4: Who are the people going to heaven, Established in Dhamma, endowed with virtue?”
sn1.47:2.1: “Those who set up a park or a grove,
sn1.47:2.2: The people who construct a bridge,
sn1.47:2.3: A place to drink and a well,
sn1.47:3.2: Both by day and by night;
sn1.47:3.4: Those are the people going to heaven, Established in Dhamma, endowed with virtue.”
